name: pm-company-income-tax
description: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon company income tax reference researched in October 2026 from the local tax code. Covers the territorial profit base, ordinary and conditional reduced rates, the annual minimum, loss carryforward limits, formation notifications and profit-return timing. Includes examples separating tax-base rounding from rate eligibility and identifies an obsolete reduced-rate band on the administration summary page. Describes the statutory instalment structure without treating an indexed historical threshold as a verified current figure. Group taxation, restructurings, treaty allocation, special gains, exemptions and independent accountant review remain outside this initial source-cited draft.
